summary: U.S. markets traded mixed on Thursday, October 1, as investors grappled with surging Treasury yields and sticky inflation data. The 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 5.33%, its highest level since April 2002, weighing heavily on rate-sensitive sectors despite Wednesday's softer PCE inflation reading. Manufacturing data showed input price pressures jumped to their highest since May, reigniting inflation fears and pushing the S&P 500 toward its worst week since August. Meanwhile, the Fed's September rate hike to 3.75-4.00%—the first increase since 2023—continues to reverberate through markets, with odds of another October hike hovering near 39%. On the crypto front, Citigroup raised its 12-month Bitcoin target to $113,000 and Ethereum to $3,028, citing resumed ETF inflows and stronger market activity. Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $2.4 billion in inflows during late September, their best week since October 2025, though BTC remains range-bound near $83,500.

signals.title: 10-Year Treasury Yields Surge to 5.33%, Highest Since 2002
signals.desc: Rising yields are pressuring equities and increasing recession concerns, with the S&P 500 on track for its worst week since August.

signals.title: Manufacturing Prices Jump to May Highs, Stoking Inflation Fears
signals.desc: ISM data showed raw material prices spiked to the highest since May, fueling expectations for another Fed rate hike in October and pressuring stocks.

signals.title: Citigroup Raises Bitcoin Target to $113K on ETF Inflow Recovery
signals.desc: Citi hiked its 12-month BTC price target by 38% and ETH to $3,028, citing $2.4 billion in late-September ETF inflows and improving macro backdrop.

signals.title: Fed Holds at 3.75-4.00%, October Hike Odds at 39%
signals.desc: Markets are pricing in a 39% chance of another 25bp hike at the October 27-28 FOMC meeting, keeping policy uncertainty elevated.

signals.title: Earnings Reports Mixed: HPE Surges on $1.2B Vultr Deal, Mattel Tumbles 4.2%
signals.desc: Hewlett Packard Enterprise jumped 3.9% after announcing a $1.2 billion cloud deal, while Mattel dropped 4.2% on CEO succession news.

verdict: Equities face headwinds from multi-decade high yields and inflation concerns, though crypto is finding support from renewed institutional flows and bullish Wall Street price targets.
